items.docs:
Creates an order which will issue account details. It should use the same currency as the balance previously created. Fulfilling all the requirements will complete the order, reaching status `DONE`.

The possible values for a requirement status are:
- `PENDING_USER`: The requirement has some pending action from the user.
- `PENDING_TW`: The requirement has some pending action from Wise.
- `DONE`: The requirement is completed.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The ID of the profile to retrieve bank account details for.

items.docs:
Returns a list with all the `AVAILABLE` and `ACTIVE` account details for the given profile, including examples. Account receive options can also include local and international details to receive money on the currency balance.

Example bank account details are returned for any currency where bank account details have not been requested and issued. Examples will always include an `id` of `null`.

items.docs:
Returns the bank account assignment requests for a profile and multi-currency account.

The response includes bank-details orders in the following statuses: `PENDING_USER`, `PENDING_TW`, `REQUIREMENTS_FULFILLED`, `DONE`.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The ID of the profile that received the payment.

params.name: paymentId
params.description: The ID of the payment to return.

items.docs:
Creates a return for a payment received to bank account details.

When you create a return, you must provide the ID of the payment you wish to return as well as the ID of the profile that received the payment. In addition, you can provide a `reason` for the return in the request body. When returning SWIFT payments, `reason` is a required field.
